article.title: Gemini API預覽按需載入工具規格，減少預先放入的內容
article.title_en: Gemini API previews on-demand tool schemas
article.summary: Google在Interactions API推出Tool Retrieval預覽，讓代理需要某項工具時才載入完整參數規格。
article.summary_en: Google introduced Tool Retrieval in preview in the Interactions API, loading complete parameter schemas when an agent needs a tool.
highlights: 模型仍會看到延後載入工具的名稱及描述。
功能支援Gemini 3.6及後續模型；推論仍按標準token費率計費。
highlights_en: The model still sees names and descriptions of deferred tools.
It supports Gemini 3.6 and later models, with standard token billing.
article.why: 串接大量行銷工具的團隊可調整代理每次請求要接收的規格，決定哪些常用工具預先載入，哪些按需搜尋。
article.why_en: Teams connecting many marketing tools can choose which schemas to load upfront and which to retrieve as needed.
article.next_step: 以同一組分析與CRM工具比較完整載入和延後載入，記錄實際輸入token及工具選擇，再決定採用範圍。
article.next_step_en: Compare full and deferred loading for the same analytics and CRM tools, recording input tokens and tool choices.
article.detail: 參數規格說明工具需要接收哪些資料。開發者可加入tool_search，並把指定工具設為defer_loading。Google亦支援遠端MCP工具及由客戶端執行的搜尋。團隊可先保留高頻工具，再測試其他工具延後載入的情況；實際費用取決於哪些規格被載入，以及後續對話使用的內容。
article.detail_en: A schema defines the data a tool expects. Developers add tool_search and mark tools with defer_loading. Remote MCP and client-side search are supported. Keep frequent tools loaded and test the remainder; actual cost depends on schemas retrieved and their later use in the conversation.
article.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
